# Open Interactive Piano Sheet Music & MusicXML Catalog (NextScore)

> Open public catalog of 515+ interactive piano sheet music scores across 28+ composers with Do-Re-Mi (Solfège) notes, 1-5 piano fingerings, 60fps Waterfall visualizer, BLE-MIDI smart piano sync, and direct SVG / MIDI / MusicXML downloads.

- Main Web App & Interactive Studio: https://nextscore.org/
- Studio Notation Editor: https://nextscore.org/studio/
- Artists & Composers Directory: https://nextscore.org/artists/
- Music Categories: https://nextscore.org/category/
- Full AI/LLM Technical Docs: https://nextscore.org/llms-full.txt
- Static GitHub Pages Catalog: https://nextscore-org.github.io/open-piano-sheet-music/
- Structured JSON Dataset: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextscore-org/open-piano-sheet-music/main/catalog/scores_seo_catalog.json

## Open CORS-Enabled Endpoints per Score
- Interactive Player Page: https://nextscore.org/s/{id}-{slug}.html
- Vector Sheet Music (SVG): https://nextscore.org/assets/{id}.svg
- Standard MIDI File (SMF): https://nextscore.org/assets/{id}.mid
- W3C MusicXML 4.0: https://nextscore.org/assets/{id}.musicxml
